title: Chapter 149 Do You Think There'S No One In My Divine Dynasty?
content:
Chapter 149 Do You Think There'S No One In My Divine Dynasty?

However, even after so many years of recuperation, the power of the lower level of their Soul Devouring Clan has not been fully restored.

If they had the strength they had back then, it would not be easy to destroy the force in front of them, but it would definitely not be so difficult.

Not to mention that it is still unknown who will win or lose.

Looking towards the depths of the Divine Dynasty Empire again, Shi Chen slowly clenched his fists.

At this time, Yan Lingyun's domineering and indifferent voice came to his ears.

"If you dare to make a move now, this emperor will immediately kill you in your Soul Devouring Realm."

"You can try."

Hearing this, Shi Chen's face was extremely ugly.

"Woman, you wait!"

Shi Chen's face was ferocious, gritting his teeth.

But there was no way, the fear of that battle still echoed in his heart.

This woman is not only a monster, but also a lunatic, who can really do anything.

If he hadn't run fast back then, he would have died tragically in that destruction.

However, although he couldn't do anything to Yan Lingyun, he was not alone.

As if thinking of something, Shi Chen's mouth corners suddenly rose slightly, and he looked in another direction intentionally or unintentionally.

There, it was the place guarded by Shen Yi, the first general of the Divine Dynasty.

What was his confidence.

That was naturally the patriarch of their Soul Devouring Clan.

In the Soul Devouring Clan, Soul Devouring was their god. In their eyes, there was nothing that Soul Devouring could not do.

Even though Soul Devouring was not Yan Lingyun's opponent in terms of strength back then.

But that was back then.

Over the years, their patriarch's strength has been constantly improving, and then look at Yan Lingyun.

Back then, they even thought Yan Lingyun was dead, and only Soul Devouring had some doubts about it.

And now, although Yan Lingyun appeared again, they didn't believe that Yan Lingyun was fine back then.

Because if Yan Lingyun was fine, I'm afraid she would have killed them in their Soul Devouring Realm again.

Of course, these are just Shi Chen's guesses.

He didn't dare to completely anger Yan Lingyun now.

What if he guessed wrong? Good luck won't always favor him.

Thinking of this, Shi Chen snorted and looked at the battlefield calmly.

At this moment, there was no change in the battlefield, and the strength difference between the top players was not big.

After all, among the same level, those who can really crush others are the minority among the minority. For example, Huang Shou is already a genius among geniuses.

And it is because of the strategic advantage.

However, at this moment, Shi Chen's face suddenly changed.

"What!"

Following Shi Chen's gaze, I saw that a super-god-level Soul Devourer was fighting against a God Dynasty strongman, but the next moment, a black light flashed, and the head of the Soul Devourer flew out.

It hasn't stopped yet, and the black light didn't stop at all, but instantly went to the next battlefield.

Seeing this scene, Shi Chen hurriedly reminded: "Be careful!"

However, it was still a step too late.

Swish!

Another Soul Devourer's head flew out.

"Ah! Damn it!!"

Although there are many strong soul-devouring people, they can't stand such killing.

Who is it? Who is it? !

At this moment on the battlefield, everyone in the Divine Dynasty also looked a little confused.

There are such powerful people on their side?

You know, because of these soul-devouring people, the entire battlefield has begun to change imperceptibly.

The surrounding space has been completely swallowed up and turned into nothingness.

In such an environment, it is naturally a big advantage for the soul-devouring people, but for the people on their side, it is a bit disadvantageous. It is no wonder that everyone is shocked that they can still have such a speed in such an environment.

At this moment, several top soul-devouring people suddenly changed their bodies. The next moment, they directly predicted the position of the black light and surrounded it directly.

"Oh, I've been discovered."

A chuckle sounded, and a familiar figure suddenly emerged slowly.

It was the leader of the Huangchenggen organization, An Xing!

At this moment, An Xing was smiling.

Nothingness?

Haha, sorry, back then, I treated the Land of Nothingness as my home.

A mere nothingness not only cannot affect me, but can even buff me.

The Soul Devouring Clan devours the energy in the surrounding void, turning it into nothingness, and I can get power from the Land of Nothingness.

To exaggerate, my current strength is even stronger than my usual self.

"Hmph, I won't give you another chance!"

"Die!"

At this time, the Soul Devouring Clan warriors suddenly rushed towards An Xing.

The aura of the Super God Realm was not concealed at all.

Facing the siege of several warriors of the same level, An Xing's face was not only not afraid, but he wanted to laugh.

"Hey, hey, hey, you don't think you can really catch me, right?"

An Xing said with a hint of sarcasm.

As the voice fell, a black domain field suddenly spread out in all directions with An Xing as the center, covering tens of thousands of miles.

Domain!

It was another domain. Seeing this scene, the faces of several Soul Devourers were extremely ugly as if they had eaten shit.

The key point is that this is not an ordinary domain.

It is different from the sword domain and belongs to a special domain.

At this moment, An Xing, who was deep in his own domain, had already disappeared without a trace, leaving only An Xing's annoying voice.

"Since you are here, don't leave. Have fun in my nothingness."

Then, countless strange forces continued to move towards the Soul Devouring Clan warriors.

In the distance, Gu Chen and his companions breathed a sigh of relief when they saw this scene, and then a smile appeared on their faces.

"Don't worry about him. An Xing never does anything he is not sure of."

Upon hearing this, Ah Wei nodded, and then slashed forward with a knife!

Swish!

Suddenly, countless Soul Devouring Clan members died tragically.

And the people of the Divine Dynasty were also delighted. This Wasteland City is really fucking reliable. Everyone is a talent.

Outside the battlefield, Shi Chen did not have any anger on his face at this moment. He just looked at the strong men on his side with a calm expression as they kept having accidents.

Have you given up?

That is naturally impossible.

Buzz——

At this moment, another space-time wormhole suddenly opened slowly in the void next to itself.

Suddenly, the faces of the people of the Divine Dynasty and Wasteland City trembled slightly.

Could it be?

No way?

At this time, Shi Chen suddenly sneered: "You don't think that my Soul Devouring Clan has only this much strength, right?"

The next moment, countless Soul Devouring Clan warriors suddenly rushed out of the space-time wormhole.

This Soul Devouring Clan army is even more terrifying than the one on the battlefield. It can be said that it is the true elite of the Soul Devouring Clan.

Boom!

Instantly, the terrifying aura once again crushed the battlefield.

For a while, everyone in the God Dynasty's Desolate City began to retreat one after another.

The momentum is oppressive!

Seeing this scene, Huang Shou and others also frowned.

Is it really going to lose?

Although they are very confident in their own strength, the overall strength gap between the two sides is too large now.

Unless,

And just when everyone looked solemn, the God of the Divine Dynasty, Yan Shenjiang, breathed a sigh of relief.

The next moment, an extremely domineering voice came from the depths of the void.

"Do you really think that there is no one in my Divine Dynasty?"

A loud bang.

The space behind him suddenly cracked, and then figures slowly emerged from it.
